title: Repospace manifest
description: Lexical validation only. Constraints that require path normalization, filesystem state, or cross-references are enforced by the tool.

version.description: Minimum schema version required to parse the file, as a string (quote it; unquoted 0.2 is a YAML number). It must name a released schema version exactly; the only one is 0.2.

defaults.description: Defaults for members in this file only; never inherited across imports.

remote.description: Remote used by members that give neither remote nor url.

remotes.description: Named URL prefixes; a member using a remote gets url-base + "/" + (repo-path or name), with trailing slashes on url-base dropped. Remote names are manifest-internal identifiers: in a cloned member the git remote is always named "origin".

members.description: The repositories that make up the repospace.

self.description: Attributes of the manifest repository itself.

name.description: Suggested clone-directory name, used by "repospace init REPOSITORY" without a DIRECTORY argument. A single plain path component that does not start with a dot.

group-filter.description: Groups disabled (-group) or enabled (+group) by default.

pathPattern.description: Glob matched against a member path from the right ("foo" matches "a/b/foo"). It must name at least one path component: "" and "." match nothing.

cmakePackageName.description: CMake package name; letters, digits, and ._+- only (not starting with punctuation), because names are interpolated into generated CMake code.

revision.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA, always a string: quote numeric-looking revisions, or YAML mangles them (1.10 becomes 1.1). Refname-safe only: no leading "-" or "+", and none of whitespace, ~ ^ : ? * [ \, ".." or "@{" -- the revision is passed to git as a fetch refspec, where each of those has a meaning of its own.

refPattern.description: Branch or tag name pattern, matched by repospace (never handed to git) against the whole name below refs/heads/ or refs/tags/: "*" and "?" stay within one "/" component, "**" spans components, "[...]" is a character class and "[!...]" its negation. A leading "!" excludes what the rest of the pattern matches, and the last pattern matching a ref decides, as in a gitignore file. Refname-safe otherwise: none of whitespace, ~ ^ : \, ".." or "@{".

selectingRefPattern.description: A pattern that selects rather than excludes, i.e. one that does not begin with "!".

heads.description: Branch name patterns. At least one must select, since an exclusion only narrows what another pattern selected.

tags.description: Tag name patterns. At least one must select, since an exclusion only narrows what another pattern selected.

heads.description: Branch name patterns. At least one, and at least one that selects: a mirror is always for at least one branch, since upstream always has a default one.

tags.description: Tag name patterns. May be empty, which mirrors no tag at all; leaving the key out mirrors every tag instead. A non-empty list must hold at least one pattern that selects.

upstream.description: The repository this member is a fork of.

remote.description: Named remote for the upstream URL (mutually exclusive with url).

repo-path.description: Suffix appended to the remote's url-base (default: the member name; mutually exclusive with url).

url.description: Complete upstream URL (mutually exclusive with remote and repo-path).

mirror.description: Upstream refs to mirror (default: every branch and every tag).

preserve.description: Origin refs that must be preserved. These are never pushed to or deleted by the mirror (default: none).

groupName.description: Group name, always a string: no leading + or -, no whitespace, commas, or colons. Quote numeric names, or YAML mangles them (1.10 becomes 1.1).

importMap.description: Import with filters. Names match exactly; path patterns match from the right. An allowlist match overrides a blocklist match; with no allowlist, everything not blocklisted is imported.

file.description: File, or directory of .yml/.yaml files, to import (default: repospace.yaml).

path-prefix.description: Prepended to the imported members' paths. The importing member's own path is not affected.

memberImport.description: Member import: true (the member's repospace.yaml), a path within the member, a filter mapping, or a sequence of those.

memberImportItem.description: Inside a sequence, false is not allowed.

selfImport.description: Self import: a path within the manifest repository, a filter mapping, or a sequence of those. Booleans are not allowed.

name.description: Unique identifier; "manifest" is reserved, path separators are not allowed.

remote.description: Named remote for the fetch URL (mutually exclusive with url).

repo-path.description: Suffix appended to the remote's url-base (default: name; mutually exclusive with url).

url.description: Complete fetch URL (mutually exclusive with remote and repo-path).

path.description: Checkout path (default: name), relative to the path-prefix accumulated by the imports that reached this file, or to the repospace topdir when there is none. The result must stay inside the repospace and outside .repospace/, with no .git component (in any case).

submodules.description: true to update all submodules recursively, or a list restricting which ones.

extension-commands.description: Extension command specification file(s), relative to the member root.

cmake-packages.description: CMake package names whose <name>_ROOT should point at this member.

import.description: Import the member's own manifest(s); mutually exclusive with groups.

groups.description: Group membership; mutually exclusive with import.
